_comment: Engagement fees — single source of truth. All fees inclusive of 18% GST, billed by Shreenu and Ranjeet Design LLP. Project Discussion and Site & Vision Walkthrough fees credited in full toward the design consultancy fee where the Agreement is signed within 90 days of payment.
